description: A maintenance script for correcting and testing statistics data in the OpenX (Revive Adserver) database, focusing on issues like multiple summarizations and incomplete data aggregation over specified date ranges.

classes.name: OX_Maintenance_Statistics_TestAndCorrect
classes.description: A class responsible for testing and correcting statistics data within a specified date range.

methods.name: checkRangeData
methods.description: Checks if the data within the specified date range is valid for correction.

methods.name: issueOne
methods.description: Corrects multiple summarizations of intermediate data into summary tables.

methods.name: issueTwo
methods.description: Corrects incomplete or missing data in the summary tables.
